name: Shidou Serina
source:
An extradimensional alien who disguises herself as an ordinary schoolgirl. She cares only about her mission to destroy demons. She'll kill anyone and anything that gets in her way.

[spoiler]As the game progresses she falls in love with Yui.[/spoiler]
translation:
An extradimensional alien who disguises herself as an ordinary schoolgirl. She cares only about her mission to destroy demons. She'll kill anyone and anything that gets in her way.

[spoiler]As the game progresses she falls in love with Yui.[/spoiler]
